title: Rewrite the function
text: Note that $$\frac{1}{\left(x-1\right)^2}=\frac{1}{\left(1-x\right)^2}$$, which is the derivative of $$\frac{1}{1-x}$$.

title: Differentiate the geometric series
text: Differentiating the geometric series term by term gives the sum of $$\left(n+1\right) x^n$$, so the coefficient of $$x^5$$ is $$6$$.
